title: Gift Card Purchase Limits on Online Orders
content:
Gift cards bought as lines of an Online Orders order are limited in value and in how they may be paid for. The limits are identical on every delivery service.

| Delivery service | Highest value of one purchased gift card (USD) | Gift card purchases per customer per calendar day, Eastern Time, at most (USD) | Gift card lines payable with stored value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 500.00 | 2000.00 | No |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 500.00 | 2000.00 | No |
| Standard Ground | 500.00 | 2000.00 | No |
| Expedited 2-Day | 500.00 | 2000.00 | No |
| Next Business Day | 500.00 | 2000.00 | No |
| Same-Day Courier | 500.00 | 2000.00 | No |

## What the limits mean

- **Highest value of one gift card**: one purchased gift card is worth at most 500.00.
- **Daily purchase limit**: the highest total value of gift cards one customer may buy per calendar day, counted in Eastern Time, is 2000.00.
- **Stored value**: "No" means gift card lines may not be paid with gift cards, store credit, Goodwill Credit or Marlowe Rewards Notes.

## Illustrations (hypothetical purchases)

| Purchase | Reading |
|---|---|
| One e-Gift Card of 500.00 | At the single-card limit; within it |
| One e-Gift Card of 550.00 | Above the single-card limit of 500.00 |
| Four gift cards of 500.00 each on one day | 2000.00 in the day; at the daily limit, within it |
| A plastic gift card line the customer wants to pay with Return Store Credit | Not payable with stored value |
